tasks.design: Configure {TRANSPORT_MODEL} native comparison reports, denoted OTHER with GIS sources. The planner verifies projections and compares exact metrics, then evaluates and writes recommendations personally. tasks.enabler_now: Native model report templates can reuse checked scenario indicators.

tasks.altitude: Human transportation recommendations with comparable scenario evidence.

evidence.claim: Transport modelling software exists; exact comparison report configuration and its saving remain a proposed local design.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; observe residual manual report alignment after existing transport model functions. Existing model runs, forecasts and runtime earn no new benefit.

Actual projection owners supply scenario_id, source_version, area_id, year and projected_values. s1 retains full scope, assumptions and currency checking; s2 retains 10 hours for metric mapping and comparability checks. Missing compatible projections use manual analysis.

No projection or measured baseline is invented. s4 captures actual recommendation, rationale, caveats and client recipient at full time. Changed text or destination requires renewed approval before send.
